title: Cowboys & Aliens
description: The Rust and Bevy rewrite of Cowboys & Aliens. Survive Iron Vein, an original compact frontier horde map built around a central plaza, two-story bank and hotel landmarks, laundry and ten-pin routes, and the connected Double Tap Alley. Repair iron window grilles, earn points, and buy from a ten-weapon frontier arsenal.
tagline: The Rust + Bevy rewrite. Survive Iron Vein.
controls: WASD moves · Mouse aims · Click fires and captures the cursor · Shift sprints · Space jumps · R reloads · E repairs iron grilles · F buys weapons or ammunition · Escape releases the cursor
